intro.zh: 你好，我是钱美含。热衷于把机械结构设计转化为可靠、可制造的产品，熟悉冲压、压铸和注塑件设计，也重视量产中的实际问题。
intro.en: Hi, I'm Meihan Qian. I enjoy turning mechanical designs into reliable, manufacturable products. My work spans stamped, die-cast, and injection-molded parts, with close attention to real production challenges.

label.en: Stamped, die-cast and molded part design

summary.zh: 参与宝马华晨项目的产品工程工作，熟悉宝马产品研发流程及 iRAM、GAMS 等研发系统，配合工程信息、变更与问题的跨团队跟进。
summary.en: Supports product engineering on a BMW Brilliance project. Familiar with BMW development processes and iRAM and GAMS systems, with a focus on cross-team follow-up of engineering information, changes, and issues.

highlights.zh: 熟悉宝马产品研发流程与项目协作方式
highlights.en: Familiar with BMW product development processes and project coordination

highlights.zh: 了解 iRAM、GAMS 等研发系统的项目使用方式

highlights.zh: 跨团队跟进工程变更、交付与问题闭环
highlights.en: Follows engineering changes, delivery, and issue closure across teams

summary.zh: 负责汽车电子控制器壳体、安装与绝缘结构开发，从结构方案、工程图纸到验证优化和量产支持。设计中兼顾装配、材料及制造可行性。
summary.en: Developed controller housings, mounting features, and insulation structures from concept and engineering drawings through validation and production support, balancing assembly, materials, and manufacturability.

highlights.zh: 设计 ECU、TCU、BMS/CSC 等产品的冲压、压铸与注塑结构
highlights.en: Designed stamped, die-cast, and injection-molded structures for ECU, TCU, and BMS/CSC programs

highlights.zh: 结合 GD&T、尺寸链、热分析与模流结果优化结构和装配
highlights.en: Used GD&T, tolerance stacks, thermal analysis, and mold-flow findings to refine structures and assembly

highlights.zh: 参与供应商技术评审、接口协调及量产问题处理
highlights.en: Joined supplier technical reviews, interface coordination, and production issue resolution

summary.zh: 支持华为、吉利和长安相关平台的结构适配与量产问题闭环。
summary.en: Supported structural adaptation and production issue closure for platform programs associated with Huawei, Geely, and Changan.

details.zh: 分析客户规格与安装条件，提出结构接口及布置建议。
details.en: Reviewed customer specifications and installation constraints to advise on structural interfaces and placement.

details.zh: 准备图纸与材料资料，配合客户及内部团队开展技术沟通。
details.en: Prepared drawings and material information for technical discussions with customers and internal teams.

details.zh: 跟进量产中的气密、翘曲与尺寸偏差，推动问题分析与闭环。
details.en: Investigated production leakage, warpage, and dimensional deviations through issue closure.

title.zh: D3 ECU 冲压壳体与热管理
title.en: D3 ECU Stamped Housing and Thermal Management

summary.zh: 设计冲压壳体、连接器与绝缘导热结构，并用热分析支持散热优化。
summary.en: Developed stamped housings, connector interfaces, and insulation structures, using thermal analysis to support heat-path optimization.

details.zh: 依据电流、散热与防护要求，参与连接器、材料及绝缘方案选择。
details.en: Contributed to connector, material, and insulation choices based on current, heat, and protection requirements.

details.zh: 完成上下冲压壳体设计及二维、三维图纸，并参与供应商技术评审。
details.en: Designed upper and lower stamped housings, released 2D/3D drawings, and joined supplier technical reviews.

details.zh: 结合热分析优化散热路径与导热材料使用。
details.en: Used thermal analysis to refine the heat path and thermal-interface material use.

title.zh: D3 TCU 压铸壳体开发

summary.zh: 设计压铸上壳体，协调供应商及 PCB 接口，支持图纸发布与量产。
summary.en: Developed a die-cast upper housing, coordinated supplier and PCB interfaces, and supported drawing release and production.

details.zh: 设计压铸上壳体并完成相关工程图纸发布。
details.en: Designed the die-cast upper housing and released engineering drawings.

details.zh: 与 PCB 团队协调元件避让区域及装配接口。
details.en: Coordinated component keep-out areas and assembly interfaces with the PCB team.

details.zh: 参与供应商技术评审，跟进结构方案向量产转化。
details.en: Joined supplier technical reviews and followed the housing design into production.

title.zh: BMS 与 CSC 注塑壳体开发
title.en: BMS and CSC Injection-Molded Housing Development

summary.zh: 设计注塑壳体、安装与卡扣结构，结合尺寸链和模流结果优化装配。
summary.en: Developed molded housings, mounting features, and snap fits, using tolerance chains and mold-flow findings to improve assembly.

details.zh: 完成 CSC 上下壳体、安装结构及相关工程图纸设计。
details.en: Designed CSC upper and lower housings, mounting features, and associated engineering drawings.

details.zh: 结合尺寸链与模流结果调整加强筋、翘曲控制及装配公差。
details.en: Used tolerance stacks and mold-flow findings to refine ribs, warpage control, and assembly tolerances.

details.zh: 参与 BMS 双面卡扣与绝缘结构开发，相关成果形成公开专利。
details.en: Contributed to BMS double-sided snap-fit and insulation structures associated with published patents.

title.zh: BMS 代工项目技术支持

summary.zh: 提供材料、密封与绝缘方案建议，配合验证问题闭环及样件开发。
summary.en: Advised on materials, sealing, and insulation while supporting validation issue closure and prototypes.

details.zh: 围绕材料、涂层、密封胶与绝缘需求提供结构技术建议。
details.en: Provided structural advice on materials, coatings, sealants, and insulation requirements.

details.zh: 协同排查设计验证阶段的连接器脱落问题并推动改进。
details.en: Helped investigate a connector retention issue during design validation and supported improvements.

details.zh: 支持多种电池管理相关模块的样件开发与技术对接。
details.en: Supported prototyping and technical coordination across battery-management modules.

title.zh: 用于BMS控制器壳体的卡扣结构和BMS控制器壳体
title.en: Buckle Structure for a BMS Controller Housing and BMS Controller Housing

summary.zh: 双面卡扣限制壳体连接位移，提升装配可靠性。
summary.en: A double-sided snap-fit limits housing joint movement for reliable assembly.
